messages.text:
"Act as an expert Senior Game Developer and Software Architect. I want you to help me design and write code for a modular 2D turn-based RPG combat system in [Insert Tech Stack, e.g., Python/Pygame, HTML5 Canvas/JavaScript, or C#/Unity].

### Core Gameplay Mechanics:
1. Turn System: Speed-based turn order (Initiative System). Characters with higher speed move first. Include a turn-order queue display.
2. Party System: 2 Player-controlled Heroes vs. 2 AI-controlled Enemies.
3. Character Stats: Max HP, Current HP, Max MP, Current MP, Base Attack, Base Defense, and Speed.
4. Player Actions:
   - Basic Attack: Deals physical damage (Formula: Damage = Attack - Target Defense).
   - Skill / Magic: Consumes MP to deal elemental damage or apply status effects (e.g., Fireball, Heal).
   - Guard: Reduces incoming damage by 50% until the character's next turn.
   - Item: Use a consumable item from a shared inventory (e.g., Health Potion).
5. Enemy AI Logic: A priority-based decision tree (e.g., heal low-HP allies, attack the squishiest hero, or cast a high-tier skill when MP is high).
6. Status Effects System: Support for basic buffs/debuffs (e.g., Poison, Stun, Attack Buff) with turn duration tracking.
7. Game State @COMMENT_BODY@ Win/Loss: Smooth transitions between Player Phase, Enemy Phase, Action Resolution, and Combat End (Victory when all enemies are defeated, Game Over when all heroes fall).

### Technical @COMMENT_BODY@ Architecture Requirements:
- Architecture: Modular structure separating Data Models, Game Logic, State Machine, and UI Engine.
- Finite State Machine (FSM): Manage turn states (Initialization, Selecting Action, Executing Action, End Turn, Victory/Defeat).
- User Interface: Display health/MP bars, visual turn order indicator, battle action menu, damage popups, and a scrollable combat log.
- Code Quality: Provide full, executable, clean code without omitted logic or `# TODO` placeholders.

### Output Required:
1. Project Folder Structure and setup instructions.
2. Complete, working code files for all core modules.
3. Step-by-step breakdown of key algorithms used (turn queue sorting, damage calculation, AI logic). (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
